Roughly 89–94% dynamical-drift cancellation still leaves a dominant residual; independently sampled prefix circuits prevent artificial qc/G2 correlation.

mechanism_analysis.dominant_source_ident.reason: Channel-isolation runs show two-qubit errors and thermal relaxation dominate, while single-qubit and readout contributions are much smaller at the tested settings. For U=10 trivial at s=0.01, isolated p2 and T1/T2 deviations are approximately 0.188 and 0.204 rad versus 0.394 rad jointly.
